title: 复习
summary: 翻开之后提交的是记得程度，用来排下次间隔。不是滑走下一张，也不是确认弹窗。
summaryEn: After the flip, commit how well you remembered — that sets the next interval. Not a swipe to the next card, and not a confirm dialog.
asks: 翻开之后提交的是记得程度，还是只是下一张？
asksEn: After the flip, does this commit how well you remembered, or just the next card?

links.when: 翻面打分不是切下一张画面
links.whenEn: grading after a flip is not advancing to the next frame

links.when: 今日无到期不是一条空提示
links.whenEn: nothing due today is not an empty notice

links.when: 三个记得程度不是确认弹窗
links.whenEn: three recall grades are not a confirm dialog
